cohort.p_e4_ancestry: unresolved; identity non-overlap is not full training independence

metrics.delta_direction: S615 minus B512; negative cross-entropy/KL indicates closer teacher alignment
metrics.exact_optimal_action_agreement: predicted legal argmax is an authenticated exact-optimal action; null for artifact_puct
metrics.exact_optimal_action_mass: legal-normalized probability on authenticated exact-optimal actions; null for artifact_puct
metrics.legal_action_probability_mass: sum of unmasked six-action model softmax on the legal action set
metrics.policy_entropy: entropy of the model policy after legal-action masking and renormalization, nats
metrics.teacher_target_cross_entropy: -sum(t[a] * log(p_legal[a])) over positive teacher target entries, nats
metrics.teacher_top_action_agreement: predicted legal argmax is among all legal teacher-target maxima
